title: Dust stakes from a stranger can price a staker out of withdrawAllUnlockedToken
rootCause: Lock lets anyone stake any amount on behalf of anyone, and Lock.withdrawAllUnlockedToken re-reads the whole lock list for every page of ten, so a stranger who adds enough one-wei locks makes that withdrawal cost more gas than a block holds.

poc.observable: test_a_strangers_dust_does_not_price_the_victim_out_of_a_withdrawal fails with "gas for the victim to withdraw: 179209853 >= 30000000"
